seoTitle: School Starts September 6: Are Your Chats Ready?
excerpt: Term dates just moved a week later. If your tuition centre's WhatsApp still shows the old date, parents are already messaging someone else.
seoDescription: Oman confirmed 6 September as the school start date. Here's how small tuition centres keep every parent's WhatsApp message answered on time.

blocks.text: Teachers went back to their classrooms yesterday. Students follow next Sunday, 6 September, a week later than many families and tuition centres had already circled on their calendars. That single week is why WhatsApp has been busier than usual since the weekend, and why the next ten days decide whether a parent enrols with you, or with whoever answers first.

segments.text: The Ministry of Education's calendar for the 2026/2027 school year sets two separate start dates this year. Teaching and administrative staff reported for duty on Sunday, 30 August. Students begin on Sunday, 6 September, a week later than the date most people expect from past years.

The extra week was added on purpose. It gives families more time in Dhofar before khareef closes on 21 September, one of the busiest tourism stretches on the calendar. Good news for hotels and tour operators. For a tuition centre, a swimming club or a language academy, it means the enrolment window everyone assumed would close by the last week of August is still wide open, and parents know it.

Ask anyone running a small tuition centre, a football academy or a nursery this week what their phone looks like, and you will hear the same thing. Messages arrive back to back, mostly in the evening, mostly from parents juggling work with a school run that has not even started yet. The questions repeat, but every parent expects a personal answer, right now, not a form they filled in three weeks ago.

items.text: Is my child's spot still confirmed for the new date?
What time does the class actually start on the 6th?
Do you have space in the evening batch now that school starts later?
Can I still pay in instalments this term?
Is the pickup van running the same route as last year?

segments.text: Check your own term dates against the ministry's calendar before you send another reply. Students start 6 September, not 30 August, and quoting the wrong date to a parent who already checked twice looks careless.
Answer enrolment messages the same day, ideally within the hour. The parent messaging you tonight is very likely messaging two other centres in the same breath.

Write down the five or six questions parents ask every enrolment season, the ones listed above, and keep short, accurate answers ready to paste. It saves your team from retyping the same schedule at ten at night.

If evening and weekend messages already outnumber what your team can answer, put something in place that keeps replying after everyone has gone home. blocks.title: Your two-minute check
paragraphs: Does every reply you send this week say 6 September for students, not 30 August?
Pull up your last ten WhatsApp enquiries. How many got a reply within the hour, and how many waited overnight?
Do you have one saved answer ready for 'is my child's spot confirmed', so nobody retypes it at ten at night?
Could a parent messaging you at midnight get something useful back before morning?

items.q: Why did the school year move a week later this year?
items.a: The Ministry of Education set students' start date at Sunday, 6 September 2026, a week after staff returned on 30 August, to give families more time in Dhofar before khareef closes on 21 September.

items.q: Does the later date apply to every school?
items.a: It applies to government schools and private schools that follow the government calendar. Schools running an international calendar keep their own dates, so check with each family before assuming.

items.q: What if I already told parents the wrong start date?
items.a: Send a short correction now with the right date and confirmed times. A plain, quick fix usually rebuilds trust faster than staying quiet about the mix up.

segments.text: Two dates decided this week for every tuition centre, club and academy: staff back on 30 August, students in class on 6 September. The businesses filling their rosters before the gates open are simply the ones answering every parent's message, with the right date, the same day it arrives.
